issue.title: 4.3: Rebuild the radial graph incrementally
issue.body_excerpt: Stop selectAll('*').remove() on every footprints tick; debounce or diff.

affected_files.role: primary - line 61 `d3.select(svgRef.current).selectAll('*').remove()` runs on every footprints useEffect tick (any time footprints or focusedPlatform change). Replace with an incremental update: keep a stable g container, join nodes/links via d3 data-join, and let the simulation's tick handler just update positions on existing selections. The unmount cleanup can still call selectAll('*').remove() on the svg to tear down DOM, but the in-tick re-render must use a join.

analysis.current_implementation: RadialGraph.jsx:61 — `d3.select(svgRef.current).selectAll('*').remove();` followed by full re-build (defs, marker, g container, links, nodes, drag handlers, tooltips). The simulation is also rebuilt every time. The useEffect runs whenever `footprints` or `focusedPlatform` changes — for live dashboards this is a churn storm.
analysis.limitations: Every live update of IndexedDB triggers a full DOM teardown + rebuild, breaking the d3 force simulation and re-paying link/node creation cost. With 500+ nodes the rebuild dominates the 60fps budget.
analysis.change_surface: 1 file. Refactor the useEffect body to: (a) keep stable container <g class='links'>, <g class='nodes'>, <g class='defs'> outside the data-driven sections, (b) do d3.select(...).selectAll('line').data(links, d => `${d.source.id}|${d.target.id}`).join(...) (and similar for nodes), (c) drive the simulation .nodes()/.force('link').links() with the new arrays, (d) let the tick callback only update x/y on the joined selection. Optionally add a `requestAnimationFrame` debounce on rapid ticks. Acceptance: `rg -n "selectAll\('\*'\)" src/dashboard/components/RadialGraph.jsx` shows only the unmount cleanup, not inside the footprints useEffect.
analysis.root_cause: RadialGraph re-creates the entire D3 graph (DOM, simulation, drag handlers) on every change of `footprints` or `focusedPlatform`, which fires on every Dexie live update. D3 supports incremental join-based updates that don't touch unchanged elements.

options.name: D3 data-join with stable key
options.summary: Refactor the useEffect to: outer setup (defs, zoom, force simulation created once via ref or memo), then on data change: d3.select('.links').selectAll('line').data(links, d => `${d.source.id}|${d.target.id}`).join(...). The simulation .nodes()/force('link').links() is updated and restarted. Tick handler updates positions on joined selections only. Unmount cleanup retains selectAll('*').remove() inside the useEffect return.
pros: Dramatic perf win on live updates
cons: Must pick a stable key (source.id+target.id for links, id for nodes)
Drag handlers, zoom behavior, and tooltips must be wired once, not per data update
options.risk_details: Risk is in the refactor: a wrong join key causes nodes to flicker, drag handlers to leak, or the simulation to lose center-node pinning (centerNode.fx/fy). Mitigated by reusing #38's chunk-isolation: the graph module only loads when graph view is active, so a regression is contained.

options.name: Debounce the rebuild only
options.summary: Keep the existing teardown-and-rebuild but wrap the effect in a 100ms debounce so rapid Dexie ticks coalesce.
cons: Still pays the full rebuild cost; only reduces frequency. Acceptance criterion is structural (the selectAll('*').remove() must not be in the footprints useEffect), so this option does NOT meet the issue's acceptance.
options.risk_details: Acceptance bar not met — fails the verify command.

options_rejected: Debounce only — fails the acceptance criterion which requires the selectAll('*').remove() to be gone from the footprints useEffect (not merely debounced)

decision_record.root_cause: RadialGraph.jsx:61 teardown-and-rebuild on every Dexie live update. D3 supports incremental joins; the current code throws away the join optimization.
decision_record.residual_risk: Drag handlers and zoom behavior must be wired once outside the data-driven loop. Verify with the issue's `rg -n "selectAll\('\*'\)" src/dashboard/components/RadialGraph.jsx` showing the match only in the unmount cleanup.
